Chat request with max_tokens=1 terminates with length finish_reason

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Liter\Llm\LiterLlm;
use Liter\Llm\ChatCompletionRequest;
$req = \Liter\Llm\ChatCompletionRequest::from_json(json_encode(["maxTokens" => 1, "messages" => [["content" => "Write a story", "role" => "user"]], "model" => "gpt-4"]));
$apiKey = getenv('API_KEY');
if ($apiKey === false || $apiKey === '') {
    throw new RuntimeException('API_KEY must be set');
}
$client = LiterLlm::createClient($apiKey);
$result = $client->chat($req);
var_dump($result->getChoices()[0]->finishReason);
var_dump($result->getChoices()[0]->getMessage()->getContent());
```
